scope: Final uncommitted RoutingSimulation component, stylesheet and seven-line RulebookPanel integration; independent Standards recheck after the previous reviewer was interrupted.

standards_basis.repository: No AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, CONTRIBUTING.md or named coding-standards file was found in the repository file inventory. Existing React interaction conventions and docs/agents/issue-tracker.md evidence and no-consumption boundaries were inspected.
standards_basis.heuristics: Applied the code-review skill smell baseline as judgement heuristics, not automatic violations. No actionable additional smell was identified within this component boundary. Formatting and typechecking are tooling responsibilities, not counted as reviewer findings.

checked_behaviors: The exact overflowing cooldown input is rejected during file import, presents an error, and sends zero simulation POSTs; 1e400 cannot become a null cooldown.
The exact nested native_settings.seed=9007199254740993 input is rejected during file import and sends zero simulation POSTs; its profile-bound integer is not silently rounded.
Independent public import cases accept and preserve literal nested seeds +9007199254740991 and -9007199254740991, and reject +9007199254740992 and -9007199254740992 before any POST.

The recursive numeric reviver rejects non-finite values and unsafe integers before accepting imported state. Finite floating values retain the existing IEEE-754 behavior; this is not arbitrary-precision decimal parsing.
Decoded duplicate keys, including Unicode-escaped spellings, are rejected while equal keys in distinct objects and delimiters inside strings remain valid.
Composing a request replaces only policy.rulebook and explicit editable task fields; frozen authorization, ceiling, groups, stages and capacity are not expanded to fit an edited rule.
Eligible candidate presentation uses the service rank; rejected reasons and unknown fields remain visible, and prototype-like labels are treated as literal text.
Final composed request size is measured in UTF-8 and blocked above 65,536 bytes before fetch. The separate 2 MB file-read guard is not presented as the API body limit.

Controlled late headers, late JSON, file text, 401 and network failures are bound to active mount/session/project/draft/edit generation. Completed reports and exports are invalidated on input changes.

history_and_attribution.overflow: Inspected preserved ui-standards-overflow.before.json: one real failed UI case. Replayed the unchanged case and unchanged original input against the final source: one passed case. The preserved HTTP comparison records original raw input rejection versus prior transformed null acceptance.
history_and_attribution.unsafe_integer: The first preserved UI execution is ui-standards-unsafe-integer.first-observed-after.json and already passes because a work-in-progress fix was present. No original failing UI run is claimed. The preserved actual JavaScript-roundtrip HTTP comparison shows the original integer selecting fixture-profile while the rounded integer loses digest-bound qualification. This review independently replays the original input successfully on final source.
history_and_attribution.other_prior_findings: Rank order, duplicate keys and the final UTF-8 limit were prior static findings with regression tests. This report does not invent pre-fix red runs for them.

replay_commands: Copy ui-standards-boundaries.case.tsx to frontend/.cache/routing-standards/boundaries.test.tsx; from frontend run npm test -- .cache/routing-standards/boundaries.test.tsx --reporter=json --outputFile=NEW-UNUSED-OUTPUT.json; remove only that temporary copy afterward.
limitations: All independently executed UI checks use jsdom and controlled HTTP receivers. Actual browser integration and server side-effect checks remain separately owned evidence.
Boundary receiver cases validate transmitted JSON and import rejection only; they do not claim those modified profile facts qualify in the real evaluator.
No provider credentials, live model calls, cash API calls, account activation, Run adoption or dispatch were exercised.
No product source, existing evidence, or git state was changed by this reviewer. Only new reviewer cases and reports were written.
The earlier Spec report binds a previous UI revision; this Standards report binds the final source below and does not relabel that earlier Spec execution as a new run.
